description:
**Present perfect continuous**（现在完成进行时）

**含义**：表示从过去开始、持续到现在并可能继续的动作，强调过程。

**结构**：have/has been + V-ing

**用法说明**：表示从过去持续到现在的动作，强调过程

**例句**：
- I've been waiting for an hour.
- She has been studying all morning.
- How long have you been working here?

**常见错误**：
- has been 后接过去分词
- 混淆：has been  vs.  has gone 

**辨析**：现在完成进行时 vs. 现在完成时：过程 vs. 结果。
meaning: 表示从过去开始、持续到现在并可能继续的动作，强调过程。
pattern: have/has been + V-ing
common_mistakes: has been 后接过去分词
混淆：has been  vs.  has gone
comparison: 现在完成进行时 vs. 现在完成时：过程 vs. 结果。

examples.example: I've been waiting for an hour.
She has been studying all morning.
How long have you been working here?

description:
**Past perfect**（过去完成时）

**含义**：表示过去某一时间之前已经发生的动作。

**结构**：had + 过去分词

**用法说明**：表示过去某一时间之前发生的动作

**例句**：
- When I arrived, she had already left.
- I had never seen such a beautiful place.
- He had finished before I came.

**常见错误**：
- 过去完成时与过去式顺序颠倒
- had 后接过去式

**注意**：过去完成时 = 过去的过去。
meaning: 表示过去某一时间之前已经发生的动作。
pattern: had + 过去分词
common_mistakes: 过去完成时与过去式顺序颠倒
had 后接过去式
notes: 过去完成时 = 过去的过去。

examples.example: When I arrived, she had already left.
I had never seen such a beautiful place.
He had finished before I came.

description:
**Past perfect continuous**（过去完成进行时）

**含义**：表示过去某一时间之前一直在持续的动作。

**结构**：had been + V-ing

**用法说明**：表示过去某时之前一直持续的动作

**例句**：
- I had been working for two hours when he called.
- She was tired because she had been running.
- They had been living there for years.

**常见错误**：
- had been 后接过去分词
- had been 与 was/were 混用

**注意**：过去完成进行时强调持续到过去某时的过程。
meaning: 表示过去某一时间之前一直在持续的动作。
pattern: had been + V-ing
common_mistakes: had been 后接过去分词
had been 与 was/were 混用
notes: 过去完成进行时强调持续到过去某时的过程。

examples.example: I had been working for two hours when he called.
She was tired because she had been running.
They had been living there for years.

description:
**Future continuous**（将来进行时）

**含义**：表示将来发生的动作、计划或预测。

**结构**：will be + V-ing

**用法说明**：表示将来某时正在进行的动作

**例句**：
- This time tomorrow, I'll be flying to Paris.
- At 8 p.m., we'll be having dinner.
- Will you be working tomorrow?

**常见错误**：
- will be 后接过去分词
- 将来进行时与 be going to 混用

**注意**：将来进行时表将来某时的背景动作。
meaning: 表示将来发生的动作、计划或预测。

common_mistakes: will be 后接过去分词
将来进行时与 be going to 混用

description:
**Future perfect**（将来完成时）

**含义**：表示将来发生的动作、计划或预测。

**结构**：will have + 过去分词

**用法说明**：表示将来某时之前完成的动作

**例句**：
- By next year, I'll have graduated.
- She will have finished by 6 p.m.
- They will have left by the time we arrive.

- 将来完成时与将来时混用
- will have 后接动词原形

description:
**Third conditional**（第三条件句）

**含义**：表示假设条件及其结果。

**结构**：If + had + 过去分词, would have + 过去分词

**例句**：
- If I had known, I would have told you.
- She would have passed if she had studied.
- If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.

**常见错误**：
- if 从句用 would have
- 主句用 had + 过去分词

**注意**：第三条件句：与过去事实相反。
meaning: 表示假设条件及其结果。

主句用 had + 过去分词

grammar: Modal verbs of deduction: must, can't, might, may
description:
**Modal verbs of deduction: must, can't, might, may**（情态动词表推测）

**含义**：表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。

**结构**：must 肯定推测；can't 否定推测；might/may 可能

**例句**：
- He must be tired. 他一定很累。
- It can't be true. 这不可能是真的。
- She might be at home.

**常见错误**：
- must 的否定用 mustn't（应为 can't）
- 混淆：might  vs.  must 程度

**注意**：must > may > might > can't（肯定→否定）。
meaning: 表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。
pattern: must 肯定推测；can't 否定推测；might/may 可能
common_mistakes: must 的否定用 mustn't（应为 can't）
混淆：might  vs.  must 程度
notes: must > may > might > can't（肯定→否定）。

examples.example: He must be tired.
It can't be true.
She might be at home.

grammar: Modal verbs of obligation: must, should, ought to, have to
description:
**Modal verbs of obligation: must, should, ought to, have to**（义务情态动词）

**含义**：表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。

**结构**：must 强烈主观；have to 客观；should/ought to 建议

**例句**：
- You must finish this today.
- You should apologise.
- You ought to see a doctor.

**常见错误**：
- ought to 后接 to 忘记
- 混淆：should  vs.  must 语气

**注意**：ought to = should，语气稍强。
meaning: 表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。
pattern: must 强烈主观；have to 客观；should/ought to 建议
common_mistakes: ought to 后接 to 忘记
混淆：should  vs.  must 语气
notes: ought to = should，语气稍强。

examples.example: You must finish this today.
You should apologise.
You ought to see a doctor.

grammar: Modal verbs of ability: can, could, be able to, manage to
description:
**Modal verbs of ability: can, could, be able to, manage to**（能力情态动词）

**含义**：表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。

- could 表过去具体能力时常用 was able to
- managed to 与 could 混用

grammar: Modal verbs of advice: should, ought to, had better
description:
**Modal verbs of advice: should, ought to, had better**（建议情态动词）

**含义**：表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。

**结构**：should/ought to 建议；had better 警告/强烈建议（不做会有后果）

- You should take a break.
- You'd better not be late.
- You ought to see a dentist.

**常见错误**：
- had better 后接 to
- 混淆：had better  vs.  should 语气

**注意**：had better 不做有负面后果。
meaning: 表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。

description:
**Reported speech with modal verbs**（间接引语与情态动词）

**含义**：表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。

**结构**：must, need, should, could 等在间接引语中常变化

**例句**：
- 'You must leave,' he said. → He said (that) I had to leave.
- 'You can go,' she said. → She said (that) I could go.
- 'I will help,' he said. → He said (that) he would help.

**常见错误**：
- must 在间接引语中仍用 must（可能变化）
- will 不变 would

**注意**：must 若表必须，间接引语常用 had to；表推测时可用 must。
meaning: 表示能力、许可、可能性、义务或建议等语气。
pattern: must, need, should, could 等在间接引语中常变化

will 不变 would
notes: must 若表必须，间接引语常用 had to；表推测时可用 must。

description:
**Passive voice (all tenses)**（全被动语态）

**含义**：表示主语是动作的承受者，而非执行者。

**用法**：所有时态都有被动形式：is done, was done, has been done, will be done。

**例句**：
- The project is being discussed now.
- The report has been finished.
- The meeting will be held tomorrow.

**常见错误**：
- 被动语态中漏掉 be 或过去分词
- 进行时被动语态结构错误

**注意**：被动语态：be + 过去分词，be 体现时态。
meaning: 表示主语是动作的承受者，而非执行者。

The meeting will be held tomorrow.

description:
**Passive voice with two objects**（双宾语被动语态）

**含义**：表示主语是动作的承受者，而非执行者。

**结构**：give/show/tell/send 等可有两个宾语，均可变被动

**例句**：
- She gave me a book. → I was given a book. / A book was given to me.
- They showed us the way. → We were shown the way.

**常见错误**：
- 双宾语被动漏 to/for
- 主动间接宾语与直接宾语位置错

**注意**：give sb sth = give sth to sb。
meaning: 表示主语是动作的承受者，而非执行者。
pattern: give/show/tell/send 等可有两个宾语，均可变被动
common_mistakes: 双宾语被动漏 to/for
主动间接宾语与直接宾语位置错
notes: give sb sth = give sth to sb。

They showed us the way. → We were shown the way.

description:
**Impersonal passive (It is said that...)**（非人称被动）

**含义**：表示主语是动作的承受者，而非执行者。

**用法**：It is said/believed/known that... / He is said to...

**例句**：
- It is said that he is rich.
- He is said to be rich.
- It is believed that she left.

- He is said to be 后接动词原形（应为 to be/完成式）
- It is said 后接 that 漏掉

**含义**：使役 have/get 复习。

**结构**：have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词

**含义**：用来修饰名词，提供额外信息。

**用法**：用逗号隔开，提供额外信息，不可用 that。

- My mother, who is 60, lives in Paris.

- The man whose car was stolen is here.

- 名词性从句用疑问语序
- 混淆：what  vs.  that 引导从句

description:
**Too / enough / so + adj + that**（too/enough/so 结构）

**含义**：用来连接句子或表达逻辑关系。

**结构**：too + adj + to do；adj + enough + to do；so + adj + that

**例句**：
- It's too cold to go out.
- He isn't old enough to drive.
- It's so cold that we stayed in.

**常见错误**：
- enough 位置错误
- 混淆：too  vs.  so 结构

**注意**：too...to 表太……而不能。
meaning: 用来连接句子或表达逻辑关系。
pattern: too + adj + to do；adj + enough + to do；so + adj + that

description:
**So + adj/adv + that**（so...that 结果从句）

**含义**：用来连接句子或表达逻辑关系。

**结构**：so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句

**例句**：
- He was so tired that he fell asleep.
- She speaks so quickly that I can't follow.
- The book was so interesting that I read it in one day.

**常见错误**：
- so 后接名词
- that 从句中仍用 so

**注意**：so 强调形容词/副词，such 强调名词短语。
meaning: 用来连接句子或表达逻辑关系。
pattern: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句
common_mistakes: so 后接名词
that 从句中仍用 so
notes: so 强调形容词/副词，such 强调名词短语。

examples.example: He was so tired that he fell asleep.
She speaks so quickly that I can't follow.
The book was so interesting that I read it in one day.

description:
**Such + noun phrase + that**（such...that 结果从句）

**含义**：such...that 结果从句。

**结构**：such + a/an + adj + 单数名词 + that；such + adj + 复数/不可数名词 + that

**例句**：
- It was such a beautiful day that we went out.
- They are such good students that everyone likes them.
- It was such bad weather that we stayed home.

**常见错误**：
- such 后接 adj 时漏 a/an
- 混淆：such  vs.  so 结构

**注意**：such + (a/an) + adj + noun + that。
meaning: such...that 结果从句。

description:

**含义**：enough 位置。

**结构**：enough + 名词（足够多）；形容词/副词 + enough（足够……）

- We have enough time.

- enough 放在形容词前

description:

**含义**：副词位置。

**用法**：频率副词在 be 后/动词前；方式副词在句末；评论副词在句首。

pattern: 频率副词在 be 后/动词前；方式副词在句末；评论副词在句首。

description:
**Word order: phrasal verbs**（短语动词词序）

**含义**：短语动词词序。

**用法**：可分短语动词：名词可放中间或后面，代词必须放中间。

- Turn off the light. / Turn the light off. / Turn it off.

**常见错误**：
- 代词放短语动词后（*pick up it*）

**常见错误**：
- 间接疑问句用疑问语序

description:
**Quantifiers with countable/uncountable**（量词与可数/不可数）

**含义**：用来连接句子或表达逻辑关系。

**结构**：many/few/a few + 可数；much/little/a little + 不可数；a lot of/lots of/plenty of 两者皆可

- 混淆：neither  vs.  none 范围

- I prefer the blue one.

- some 替代单数名词
